title: Dynamic Batching Advisor & Safe-Apply Audit Hub
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an integrated recommendation card and audit hub in Optimize that suggests workload-specific batching and KV-caching profiles, shows a clear generated diff preview for config changes, and captures an immutable apply/rollback audit trail for compliance and troubleshooting.
background: Customer feedback and internal incident reviews show that teams hesitate to accept Optimize suggestions because they cannot clearly preview cost/latency trade-offs or rollback easily when a suggestion impacts output quality. Engineering has landed batched execution primitives and a KV cache toggle in runtime-1.22; product needs a trusted UI flow that pairs automated suggestions with guardrails (preview diffs, staged safe-apply, and a searchable audit history).
proposed_solution: Introduce a new Recommendation Card type: 'Dynamic Batching Advisor' that produces 1) a per-suggestion diff (JSON + human-readable), 2) a staged 'safe-apply' flow with canary rollout controls, and 3) an 'Apply History' tab in Optimize with immutable records and quick-rollback. Cards will include simulated cost delta, latency delta (p50/p95), and a quality risk tag. The staged apply will write an audit record and create a one-click rollback action that triggers a revert job in the control plane and notifies linked routes. UI will link directly to the runtime simulation dashboard and the GitHub PR (if enabled).
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation card renders for 3 sample workloads (chat short, chat long, embeddings) with generated diff and human summary.
Diff preview shows side-by-side old vs proposed config, estimated cost delta, estimated latency p50/p95, and risk tag.
Safe-apply flow supports: immediate apply, canary apply to 5% of traffic, and scheduled apply with rollout windows.
Apply History tab stores immutable records: who applied, when, change diff, simulation metrics, and a revert action.
One-click revert triggers a backend revert job and shows status in the audit trail; revert resolves with success/failure and a link to the revert run log.
All UI text and tooltips pass legal/compliance review for auditability (include reason field on apply).
End-to-end integration tests exercising canary and rollback pass in CI and are linked from the ticket.
Telemetry: cost delta estimate accuracy within 25% vs observed after 24h for sample workloads during staged rollout.
design_notes: Card compact layout: left column summary + cost/latency badges; middle column diff preview collapsed by default; right column actions (Preview, Safe-Apply, Schedule, Dismiss).
Diff format: machine-readable JSON with a highlighted human-summary header. Use color-coding for fields with direct perf/cost impact (batch_size, cache_ttl, quantization_profile).
Accessibility: keyboard-first actions for apply/revert; tooltips should be read by screen readers.
Audit records are immutable and exportable as NDJSON for downstream compliance ingestion.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal alpha): expose to Redwood internal org only; connect to runtime staging and use three synthetic workloads. (2 weeks)
Phase 1 (beta): enable for 10 pilot customers with guardrails and telemetry; require opt-in and notify account owners. (4 weeks)
Phase 2 (general availability): open to all accounts with default 'preview first' UX and optional auto-apply for enterprise. (2 weeks)
Monitoring: create dashboard for apply failures, revert rate, and cost-estimate drift.
metrics: Adoption: % of Optimize recommendations viewed vs applied
Safety: revert rate within 48h of apply
Business: realized cost savings (USD) attributable to applied recommendations
Quality: percent of applied recommendations that trigger model-regression alerts
